# The Foot Capacity System

> A guided home recovery program for plantar fasciitis and heel pain, delivered through the Foot Capacity System app. Created by Dr. Jonathan Schutza, PT, DPT, a licensed physical therapist. The program runs in three phases over about 12 weeks, with daily guided exercises, pain tracking, flare-up guidance, and Ask Dr. Jonathan AI.

## What it is

- A structured, app-based home program for plantar fasciitis and heel pain.
- Three phases, about 12 weeks.
- Daily guided exercises with video instruction, pain tracking and progress history, built-in guidance for flare-ups and tougher days, and Ask Dr. Jonathan AI for questions about the program.
- The app is not a diagnosis tool and does not replace an in-person medical evaluation.

## Getting started

- Free to start: sign up with an email address. No payment details are needed to begin.
- After 7 logged days of check-ins, members choose a paid plan to continue.

## Plans and prices (US dollars)

All four plans are explained at https://fixyourmovement.com/foot-capacity-system. Checkout is processed by Whop.

- Recovery Plan: $47 per month. Full program with Ask Dr. Jonathan AI. Bills monthly until cancelled. Does not include direct messaging with Dr. Jonathan.
- Ownership Plan: $97 per month for 6 payments, then lifetime program access with no further charges. Includes 6 months of direct messaging with Dr. Jonathan.
- Lifetime: $297 one-time payment for lifetime program access with Ask Dr. Jonathan AI. Does not include direct messaging with Dr. Jonathan.
- Premium Lifetime: $497 one-time payment for lifetime program access, Ask Dr. Jonathan AI, and 6 months of direct messaging with Dr. Jonathan.

HSA/FSA: many plans reimburse qualified healthcare expenses; the plan administrator decides eligibility. Details: https://fixyourmovement.com/hsa-fsa
